The rejected cycle then published the one-instrument reading as the whole product-facing enforcement envelope (evaluation/rebuild_preflight.py::envelope_from_legs, field what_a_rebuilt_packet_cannot_be_blocked_on[1] = 'any label regression once its scored counter-row count differs from 65'), which is FALSE against accepted evidence sitting in the same tree.
errata.pins_are_additive_not_substitutive: These three pins are declared here and carried in evaluation/rebuild_preflight.py::LINEAGE_INSTRUMENT_PINS. Every one of the eight ORIGINAL freeze pins is retained byte-identically in FROZEN_INPUTS; none is removed, replaced or weakened. The module re-hashes BOTH blocks after execution and publishes them under separate keys (frozen_input_rehash_after_execution.freeze_pinned_instruments and .additive_lineage_instruments) so the two sets can never be blurred.
errata.the_added_instrument_is_already_accepted: label_lineage_gate.py / run_label_lineage_gate.py / LABEL_LINEAGE_VERDICT.json were accepted in cycle 39020603510 (audit CYCLE_39020603510_GATE.json, gate=PASS, safe_to_integrate=true) under their own pre-execution freeze results/evaluation/label_lineage_gate/freeze/FROZEN_HYPOTHESIS_39020603510.json. errata.original_wording_verbatim_rejected_cycle: Leg E prediction (label bar blocks a rebuilt packet) was falsified.
errata.defect: POST-HOC REFRAMING OF A FROZEN PREDICTION. The freeze's actual leg-E prediction is quoted verbatim below; 'label bar blocks a rebuilt packet' is a DIFFERENT prediction that the freeze never made. The freeze's own success-rule clause forbids exactly this: 'Predictions are not edited after observation; a falsified prediction is published as a falsification with its wording correction.' A substitution in the report is an edit by another name.
errata.frozen_leg_e_prediction_verbatim: both exits are non-zero (2 environment error or 1 regression) and neither record may be consumed as a pass; a missing input must never produce exit 0
errata.correction_of_record: The frozen leg-E prediction concerned the TWO run_bar_gates --adjudicate exit codes of leg E's two sub-packets (an empty packet dir and a zero-counter-row packet). MEASURED: exit_codes [2, 0] — the empty dir exits 2 as predicted, the zero-counter-row packet exits 0. The frozen prediction is therefore FALSIFIED, and the falsification is published as such. The rejected report's parenthetical restatement ('label bar blocks a rebuilt packet') is WITHDRAWN as a misstatement of what was frozen. The repaired record quotes the frozen wording verbatim in legs.E_refusal_negative_control.prediction and scopes it in .prediction_scope; headline finding PF3 states the falsification with the frozen wording in its prediction_source.
errata.the_falsification_itself_is_preserved: Leg E remains FALSIFIED under the repair. success_rule_holds stays false and the verdict stays PREFLIGHT_INCOMPLETE. The repair does not re-run the leg to obtain a green rule; it discloses the verdict (audit required fix M2) and restores the frozen wording (M3).

Read product-facing, it asserts that a rebuilt packet cannot be blocked on a label regression off the 65-row population. The accepted population-free lineage gate blocks exactly that case.
errata.correction_of_record: The freeze's claim-ceiling phrase 'population-pinned label bar' is scoped, as of repair r1, to the accepted run_bar_gates LABEL half alone. The repaired record's own claim_ceiling supersedes the freeze's forward wording and states the two-bar envelope: the run_bar_gates LABEL half blocks only on the exact 65-row incumbent population; the accepted label_lineage_gate blocks a three-frozen-qid lineage packet whose pooled support rate is strictly below the derived 5/65; a packet issuing no scored counter row at all is blocked by neither and certified sound by neither.
